title: Egypt — Arab Spring 2011
description: Protestas en Plaza Tahrir. Contagio de protesta tipo SIR. Internet apagado el 28-Ene. Mubarak renunció el 11-Feb.
data_notes: P represents fraction_participating (units: fraction_participating). Series reconstructed from published research sources (empirical_estimated). Observation operator H: fraction(|opinion| > 0.5). At Tier 1 (< 500 observations), only aggregate parameters can be calibrated against this case; see docs/validation/PROMPT_CALIBRACION_EQUIPO_AGENTES.md.
observation_operator_description: Protest participation fraction: P follows SIR contagion curve. Observation operator H: fraction of agents with |opinion| > 0.5 (strong mobilization threshold in bipolar encoding).
